evidence-graph.definition: Every claim the system makes points at the artifact that justifies it, and the graph is queryable after the fact.
evidence-graph.steal_this: Store the citation as a first-class row, not a footnote. The moment evidence is structured, 'explain yourself' becomes a SELECT.

price-before-generate.definition: The true cost and success odds of an expensive generation step are quoted before the user commits, so spend is a choice.
price-before-generate.steal_this: Model your most expensive operation as a priced quote with an expected-retry figure. Users forgive slowness, not surprise bills.

human-holds-the-last-button.definition: Autonomy is bounded by an irreversible-action gate that only a named person can release.
human-holds-the-last-button.steal_this: Decide which single action is expensive enough to require a human, and make that gate a schema state transition rather than a prompt request.

deterministic-guardrail.definition: Hard requirements are enforced by the runtime, not by asking a model politely.
deterministic-guardrail.steal_this: Anything the architecture can enforce, the architecture enforces. Probabilistic components get proposals; deterministic components get verdicts.

make-the-invisible-measurable.definition: A felt-but-unmeasured phenomenon (jank, grief, bias, fatigue) is converted into a number with a before/after delta.
make-the-invisible-measurable.steal_this: Find the metric practitioners already eyeball, instrument it, and ship the delta. A number turns a vibe into a product.

offline-first-fallback.definition: The feature works with no network; cloud is an upgrade, not a dependency.
offline-first-fallback.steal_this: Put the model on the device and make connectivity a quality setting. It reads as a privacy feature and buys reliability for free.

long-horizon-watcher.definition: The agent persists across days, sleeping until the world changes, instead of answering in one session.
long-horizon-watcher.steal_this: Replace chat turns with a scheduled process that wakes on a condition. Patience is a feature nobody else ships.

verification-first.definition: Nothing is emitted until it has been checked against an independent source; the check, not the generation, is the product.
verification-first.steal_this: Invert the pipeline: generate last, verify first. Ship the checker as the artifact and the content as its output.

wrap-the-legacy-surface.definition: Instead of migrating users, the new capability is embedded into the surface they already live in.
wrap-the-legacy-surface.steal_this: Ship as a plugin/widget/block inside the incumbent UI. Adoption is one checkbox, not a migration project.

crew-of-specialists.definition: A job normally done by one generalist is decomposed into named specialist roles that check each other.
crew-of-specialists.steal_this: Name the roles, give each a single responsibility and an output contract, and let the handoffs be where quality is enforced.

artifacts-not-forms.definition: Structured intake is replaced by capturing a raw artifact (photo, recording, log) and deriving the form from it.
artifacts-not-forms.steal_this: Ask for the thing the user already has, then do the parsing. Every field you don't ask for is a user who doesn't churn.

constraint-is-the-feature.definition: A limitation (no budget, no GPU, no internet, no data rights) is designed into the value proposition rather than apologized for.
constraint-is-the-feature.steal_this: Take the constraint you were going to write a workaround for, and make it the headline. Broken-and-proud beats blocked-and-polished.

data-flywheel.definition: Every user interaction writes a labeled row that measurably improves the next one, and the improvement is surfaced to the user.
data-flywheel.steal_this: Log the verdict (keep/again, accept/reject) next to the input, and tell users their own history now drives the estimate.

model-cost-routing.definition: Work is assigned to models by shape and price of the task, with the expensive tier reserved for foundation decisions.
model-cost-routing.steal_this: Classify each step as judgement vs. format vs. volume, then route. Save the frontier model for the one call everything downstream depends on.

single-input-ux.definition: One affordance (a file drop, a button, a yes/no) replaces the prompt box; the system asks with candidates, not blank fields.
single-input-ux.steal_this: Ban the text box. When you need information, render 2-4 options. The product stops demanding literacy in your tool's language.

privacy-as-architecture.definition: Data ownership is enforced by where bytes live, and the user can verify the claim.
privacy-as-architecture.steal_this: Move the sensitive step to the user's machine, then prove it with an auditable claim (no egress, local model hash, exportable data).

institutional-grade-reliability.definition: A hackathon surface wearing enterprise armor: immutable logs, versioned rules, replayable state, or crypto verification.
institutional-grade-reliability.steal_this: Adopt one boring enterprise discipline (append-only audit, signed config, replay on boot) and let it be the reason a buyer trusts you.

narrow-domain-deep-model.definition: A tiny model or rules engine tuned to one vertical beats a general model prompted at it.
narrow-domain-deep-model.steal_this: Pick the narrowest slice you can own, then fine-tune or rule-code it until it is unarguably better on that slice's eval.
